rationale.consistency: Follows Caddy idioms and wrapper usage, though the Caddyfile parser mixes time.ParseDuration with caddy.ParseDuration.
rationale.edge_cases: Per-route idle deadlines bypass server-wide hard deadlines; negative idle timeouts with min rates incorrectly shrink the burst allowance.
rationale.scope: Implements the requirement, but deleting timeouts from request_body breaks existing configurations that relied on them.
rationale.readability: Cleanly structured with clear abstractions like IdleDeadline and well-placed comments explaining the chunking loop.
rationale.robustness: Safely handles unsupported deadlines; io.LimitReader brilliantly chunks ReadFrom without defeating underlying sendfile optimizations.
rationale.maintainability: Deadline logic is well-encapsulated and easy to reason about, though the per-route handler fails to inherit server context.
